messages:
Ria Patel: Heads-up, saw ~18 inbound leads in HubSpot with owner=null for >30m this morning. Enrichment API returning repeated 504s.
Sam Nguyen: Ugh. Any pattern on region/timezone or enqueue timing?
Ria Patel: Mostly EMEA/APAC created between 02:00-06:00 UTC. enrichment-service v2 logs show timeouts and retries.
Marco Li: That overlaps the nightly RR maintenance window. We may be delaying RR until enrichment completes which is bad.
Leah O'Connor: SLA says assign owner within 15m. We should not block RR on enrichment. Propose fallback after 15m + tag for re-enrichment.
Sam Nguyen: Quick patch idea: trigger RR with owner assignment after min(enrichment_ttl, 15m). If still no owner by 15m, assign `sales_queue_default` and add tag `needs-reenrichment`.
Marco Li: I can add a HubSpot workflow condition. Pseudocode:
```
IF lead.status = "new" AND owner IS NULL AND now() - created_at > 900
THEN assign owner = sales_queue_default, add_tag = "needs-reenrichment"
```
We will continue async enrichment and update owner if it completes within 24h.
Leah O'Connor: Also make RR skip reps with timezone_blackout during their local night to avoid waking people up.
Ria Patel: We only use `working_hours` in SF rules today, not a timezone blackout flag. Need mapping service or tz-check.
Sam Nguyen: I'll prototype a small tz-check endpoint (`GET /tz-check?rep_id=...`) returning true/false. Add to RR service. Cron smoke tests: `0 */6 * * *`.
Marco Li: Two infra asks: 1) add Console metric for `unassigned_leads_>15m`, 2) emit an ops event so salesops gets a Slack alert earlier.
OpsBot: alert:lead-routing-unowned_count=18, threshold=5  posted to #marketing/salesops
Leah O'Connor: Add dead-letter after 3 enrichment attempts -> route to manual queue. No infinite retries.
Sam Nguyen: agree. attempt_count + deadletter after 3. I'll add to playbook: https://redwood.company/ops/routing-playbook (internal).
Ria Patel: I'll update the playbook with fallback flow and get ops/sales sign-off. Planning a 48h canary on 10% of inbound before full rollout.
Marco Li: Rolling RR tz-check to staging now behind feature flag `rr_tz_grace_v2`.
Leah O'Connor: Good. Target: reduce >15m unassigned to <1% after canary. Also ensure backoff multiplier for the enrichment vendor if 504s recur.
Sam Nguyen: Creating ticket INBOUND-423 for patch + docs, assigning to Marco and Ria: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INBOUND-423
Ria Patel: Ping me when canary is live, will monitor the owner latency metric and re-enrichment rate.
Leah O'Connor: Thanks all. Quick wins: implement HubSpot fallback condition, tz-aware RR skip, metrics + Slack alert, dead-letter after 3 attempts. Can we aim to have a hotfix and docs within 24h?
Sam Nguyen: I'll try for hotfix PR within 24h, docs + playbook update in parallel.
Marco Li: On it.
Leah O'Connor: :rocket:
